description: This file 'log_extract.py' is a script for extracting and benchmarking TorchScript IR logs. It contains functions for parsing command-line arguments, processing log files, running various IR benchmarking routines, and outputting IR data. It serves as an entry point for IR extraction and analysis tools related to TorchScript and JIT logs.
